explanation: Happy or blessed; a state where people experience true joy through their relationship with God, regardless of external circumstances.
Followers who recognize their total need for God's grace and lack of their own righteousness.
Deep pain or sorrow over sin in the world; an attitude that leads to inner purity and comfort from God.
Gentle, humble, and not vengeful; those who show meekness will receive God's righteousness.
An intense longing to live in accordance with God's laws and see his righteousness fulfilled on earth.
People who show grace, forgiveness, and care for others; they themselves will receive mercy from God.
Those with a pure inner attitude, free from impure motives and without duplicity; these shall see God.
Those who actively promote peace and reconciliation among people; they are called children of God.
People who suffer or are harassed because of their faith in Jesus Christ; their reward is in heaven.
A metaphor for the disciples' ability to preserve morality in society and prevent moral decay.
A symbol that Christians should show forth God's truth and goodness so that others may see good deeds and glorify God.
